title: Sharanawa language
extract: Sharanawa is a Panoan language of Peru. There are 200 Sharanawa in Brazil, but only 3 speak the language. Its speakers call the language Arara. The Mastanawa dialect may belong to either Sharanawa or Yaminawa, although the Mastanawa regarded their language to be identical with Sharanawa.
